description: The great-circle distance between two points in km and miles, the initial bearing and the midpoint. Each point is a lat,lon pair or a place name (geocoded with OpenStreetMap data, ODbL). Straight-line distance only, not a route. Takes about 13 s; allow a 30 s timeout. Price: $0.002 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.
name: distance
title: The great-circle distance between two points in km
